Claim: `domain:ui` execution seat (objectui), session `session_011SfZeFWrhGLHmfq61xbz4q`, round 27.
Branch: `claude/issue-6378-boot-flash`

Serial constraints — file face, located on `origin/main`: `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/LoadingScreen.tsx`, `chrome/RouteFader.tsx`, `chrome/ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx`, `apps/console/src/App.tsx` / `AppContent.tsx`, and the existing `e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts` scaffolding.

Non-overlap, checked directory by directory — three cards touch `app-shell` and none shares a file with this one: #6240 is `src/services/`, #6443 (PR #6486, queued) is `src/providers/`, #6464 (PR #6485, queued) is `src/views/` plus `plugin-detail` and `react`. This card is `src/chrome/`. Note also that `apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx` is a **different file** from `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx`, which #6443 touched — same basename, different package.

**The measure-first charter is the whole card.** Triage named `LoadingScreen` unmount timing and `RouteFader` as *suspects* and said neither is established. ⛔ No fix from a guessed cause: DOM-state timestamps correlated with the frame ledger come first, extending the landed e2e scaffolding.

⭐ **And the acceptance bar is higher than the discovery's.** The card's own honest caveat is n=9 on a defect that reproduces on roughly one boot in three — so a fix cannot be accepted on a handful of clean runs. Whoever takes this should say what run count makes "the flash is gone" a measurement rather than luck, and hit it.

File-face amendment — `domain:ui` dev seat, branch `claude/issue-6378-boot-flash`, PR #6506 (draft).

The measure-first charter moved the file face. The declared face named `chrome/{LoadingScreen,RouteFader,ConditionalAuthWrapper}.tsx` on the strength of two suspects; the ledger exonerated both and put the defect at two call sites outside it. Declaring the widening in the same round, per the bounded in-place rule.

**Added to the face:**

- `packages/app-shell/src/chrome/RedirectWithSplash.tsx` (new) — inside the declared `src/chrome/` area.
- `apps/console/src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx` — `LoginRedirect`, the signed-out boot's 41 ms window.
- `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx` — the signed-in boot's 147 ms window, the widest measured.
- `packages/app-shell/src/{chrome/index.ts,index.ts}` — the two barrel hops.
- Three test files that enumerate the app-shell barrel and would otherwise resolve the new symbol to `undefined`: `apps/console/src/__tests__/{App.docsPortalLazy,internalFormShell}.test.tsx` and `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.route.test.tsx`.

**Not touched, and worth recording as a correction to the card's premise:** `RouteFader.tsx` and `ConditionalAuthWrapper.tsx`. `RouteFader` never mounts on the boot path in either boot (`fader=false` in every DOM event of all 204 runs) — it lives inside `/apps/:appName/*`. `ConditionalAuthWrapper` is exported by app-shell but **the console does not use it at all**; `apps/console/src/App.tsx` mounts `AuthProvider` directly.

**Non-overlap re-checked at the moment of widening**, against all nine open PRs' file lists: none touches any of the above. The three live `app-shell` cards remain in `src/services/` (#6240), `src/providers/` (#6443) and `src/views/` (#6464).

The same defect class survives at six more gates in `packages/app-shell/src/console/`, on paths this card's instrument never exercised — filed unassigned as #6507 rather than widened into here.
